notes_for_editor: Thin record: one tower list is the only source; no build, design, staffing, status or access source was found. The companion entry us-ga-pineland (GA095) sits about 4.8 km north-north-west of this tower by the listed coordinates (distance computed; bearing about 343 degrees); the editor should check whether these are two towers or one. The list's elevation column has no unit; 136 is read as feet. The list's naming note says names for towers 73 and above are the author's own creation (this tower is GA265), so 'pineland GFC' is not evidence of a historical name. The record's register reads 'BLL US 65194', but the list tags it 'BLL-65194' with no 'US'; check the format before changing it. The 2026 Pineland Road Fire in Echols and Clinch counties turned up in searches but no source ties it to this tower, so it is not used. Searches ran through websearch.py and were shared with us-ga-pineland.
